Figure 80 and 81 summarize the flexural strength and modulus for cross-ply tested in 0 deg and 90 deg at two facilities – UT and ORNL for sake of comparison between two labs. Also one variant was pressed at 25 tons (higher tonnage) compared to 10 ton used for all plates. This data was also compared to TCF (called LCCF in the graph) and Zoltek (non-aerospace commercial 50k tow PANEX 35 fiber). The data is very repeatable and shows 300 MPa flexural strength and 20 GPa 58 modulus for the rCF, which is comparable to chopped TCF and Zoltek fibers. The plate pressed at higher tonnage attained 400 MPa strength and 35 GPa flexural modulus, indicating that these materials can be pressed at higher tonnage.
